contract.purpose: Keep Fleet feedback reachable without obscuring product actions, titles, or newsletter controls.
contract.purposeSource: Feedback issue #163 and owner-approved direction contract
contract.canonicalPurpose: One shared in-flow footer support section opens the existing feedback dialog while preserving each product's own page and newsletter experience.
contract.audience: Visitors using products that include the shared footer integration or React package
contract.job: Send a question, bug report, or product idea without losing their place or covering page controls.
contract.thesis: Feedback belongs beside footer support and newsletter actions in normal page flow.
contract.system: Existing shared AI/project footer composition, neutral border and surface tokens, and React widget styles; no new runtime dependency.
contract.signature: A product-specific support card in document flow, followed by the site's newsletter controls.
contract.risk: The action is less immediately discoverable than a persistent floating button.
